in_sanskrit.name: Gannath
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gannath एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gana means 'group or assembly' and Isha means 'lord' or 'god'. The name Gannath signifies the one who is the lord of all beings, the universal ruler. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha, known as Gannath, is revered as the god of wisdom, knowledge, and new beginnings.
